title: Boom or burst: integration of CERK1 activation by OXI1 sheds light on ROS signalling during PTI
content: Pattern-triggered immunity (PTI) is activated when conserved, microbe-derived ligands known as pathogen/microbe associated molecular patterns bind to specialized cell-surface receptors called pattern recognition receptors (PRRs). This family of proteins consists of receptor-like kinases and receptor-like proteins whose activation triggers a series of signaling events that lead to reactive oxygen species (ROS) burst, mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) cascades, and the induction of pathogenesis response (PR) genes (DeFalco and Zipfel 2021).
